gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) detail[] 49-53 are the five utility/Orner rows of the p13 'Statement of Receipts and Disbursements - Actual Compared to Budgetary Basis (Non-GAAP) - All Funds' (Electric utility 552,870, Solid waste 49,122, Wastewater 101,789, Water 111,306, Orner Apartments 20,413 = 835,500): a combined all-funds budgetary-basis schedule, cash disbursements not the GAAP expenses the statement prints, so they cannot reconcile. Under the per-fund rule (combined all-funds schedule replaced by the individual fund columns) they are removed. (2) The proprietary funds statement p10 fund columns are added, one line per printed non-zero cell: Light 45,860+20,409+1,760+26,153+9,806+1,380+7,765+535+4,888+355,463+10,138+63,808+46,782 = 594,747 (printed 594,749); Water 34,919+14,842+26,609+7,658+6,557+250+9,934+20,461+12,000+1,397 = 134,627; Sewer 23,831+11,636+2,645+1,174+6,209+150+2,274+37,727+11,826+12,386+6,753 = 116,611 (printed 116,612); Compactor 18,410+1,396+23,048+1,416+670+5,888 = 50,828; Orner Apartments 556+40+1,671+13,508+946+2,194+2,200+7,448 = 28,563. Added 925,376. 835,500 + 925,376 - 835,500 = 925,376 vs statement_total 925,377: residual 1 = the Totals column Sales tax 54,933 (in the JSON statement line) vs fund cells 46,782+1,397+6,753 = 54,932 (page rounding; the report's own Insurance/Utilities totals are also 1 off each, see report_discrepancies).
